title: crisp pastel curtains playing the bongo martillo
story: Kitipun opens out of silence on one big chord (onset 31.5@33) and a sparse guitar intro: three thin lilac threads fade up slowly with the voice, nothing pulsed because no drum plays. At 396 (STEP+, KEY C) the band comes in and the palette warms from lilac to rose-coral; speed stays 0.4 throughout. From 536 the bongo martillo plays (eighths every 7.26 ticks, 58-tick bars): every stroke flashes the emphasised curtain (enfasis_fuerza), bright slaps also open the contrast, and the dark open tone near beat 4 flares the outer curtains with impacto and a brightness lift. Every half bar the structure flips: bands close with the emphasis low and a rose hue on beat 1, open with the emphasis high and a lilac hue on beat 3, drifting a little each bar.

KEY B, centroid 0.223 (brightest timbre of the intro), rms 0.237: curtains brighter, separacion 1.9->1.6 lets more bands in

hold 21 ticks before the band: rms 0.128, centroid 0.102 (quietest point of the intro). No bongo in the intro: the onsets 8..396 have no periodicity (autocorrelation 0.6 vs 4.5 in the groove) - nothing is pulsed

STEP+ rms 0.203->0.274, onset 10.98@416 PEAK, KEY C: the band comes in. The warm move: col_hue -0.07 -> +0.05 (lilac to rose-coral), saturation and brightness up, every curtain lifts, bands close (separacion 1.25), glow tightens to 0.015 (crisp). Speed stays 0.4
